quote: The world cares very little about what a man or woman knows; it is what a man or woman is able to do that counts.
author: Booker T. Washington

author: William Penn

quote: Twenty years from now you will be more disappointed by the things that you didn't do than by the ones you did do.
author: Mark Twain

quote: You get peace of mind not by thinking about it or imagining it, but by quietening and relaxing the restless mind.

author: Buddha

author: William Shakespeare

author: Thomas à Kempis

author: George Santayana

author: Abraham Lincoln

author: Naruto Uzumaki

author: Leonardo da Vinci

author: Edward de Bono

author: Blaise Pascal

author: John Astin

author: Buddha

author: Henry Ford

author: Wayne Dyer

author: Confucius

author: Diogenes

author: Ezra Stiles

author: Lou Holtz

author: Booker T. Washington

author: Mary Pickford

author: Lord Byron

author: Buddha

author: Anaïs Nin

author: Sai Baba

author: Madame de Stael

author: Buddha

author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

author: Epictetus

author: Buddha

author: Daisaku Ikeda

author: Buddha

author: Lao Tzu

author: Buddha

author: Seneca the Younger

author: Buddha

author: G. K. Chesterton

author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

author: Robert Southey

author: Kahlil Gibran

author: Buddha

author: Helen Keller

author: Junichirou Kagami

author: Lucille Ball

author: Albert Schweitzer

author: Peter Abelard

author: Marcus Aurelius

author: Laura Teresa Marquez

quote: I don't believe you have to be better than everybody else. I believe you have to be better than you ever thought you could be.
author: Ken Venturi

author: Buddha

quote: Sweet is the memory of distant friends! Like the mellow rays of the departing sun, it falls tenderly, yet sadly, on the heart.
author: Washington Irving

quote: The future is an opaque mirror. Anyone who tries to look into it sees nothing but the dim outlines of an old and worried face.
author: Jim Bishop

quote: The moment one gives close attention to anything, it becomes a mysterious, awesome, indescribably magnificent world in itself.
author: Henry Miller

quote: The thing that is disliked by me is also disliked by others. Since I dislike this thing, how can I inflict it on someone else?
author: Buddha

author: William Londen

author: Swami Vivekananda

author: Marcus Aurelius

author: Byron Pulsifer

author: Leonardo da Vinci

author: Harold Geneen

author: Thornton Wilder

quote: Peace is not something you wish for. It's something you make, something you do, something you are, and something you give away.
author: Robert Fulghum

author: Alfred Korzybski

author: Joan Didion

author: Mother Angelica
